query_text: advance auto human resources phone number

action.query: Advance Auto Parts human resources phone number employee HR contact
queries: Advance Auto Parts human resources phone number employee HR contact

content.text:
Advance Auto Parts’ general customer service number is **1-877-238-2623**. Their Team Member Hotline is listed as **1-800-277-2900** in company policy materials. ([shop.advanceautoparts.com](https://shop.advanceautoparts.com/o/contact-us?msockid=08b94f216cfc662b013e59d16df867ed&utm_source=openai))

For **HR-specific help**, third-party directories commonly list **540-362-4911**, but I’d verify through your store manager, employee portal, or the general customer service line because HR numbers can change. ([employmentverifications.org](https://www.employmentverifications.org/advance-auto-parts/?utm_source=openai))

If you’re a current employee, you can also look for your local HR contact on the posted **Open Door Policy** page at your store.
